title: Boston Gas Company files for review and approval an amendment to the 275 Firm Transportation contract with Boston College dated September 28, 1998 and approved by the Department on November 30, 1998.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department approves the proposed amendment. Commissioners participating were: James Connelly, Chairman; Coommissioners W. Robert Keating, Paul B. Vasington, Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr., and Deirdre K. Manning. (GC 00-32)
